name: nota_comercial_b3_payload
description: Monta o struct 'payload' Nota Comercial/B3 em camadas with_columns. Parcelas agregadas via window function (collect_list over numero_contrato) — sem self-join. 4 outputs com transformações específicas para Kafka + 3 Deltas.

transformations.name: payment_method
transformations.expression: struct(lpad(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_metodo_pagamento, 2, '0') as paymentMethodCode, lpad(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_do_indexador, 4, '0') as indexCode, CASE WHEN cast(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_do_indexador as int) IN (20, 99) THEN NULL ELSE cast(percentual_taxa_variavel as float) END as rateFloatingPercentage, cast(informacoes_adicionais.taxa_contrato as int) as interestRateSpread, codigo_criterio_calculo_juros as interestCalculationCriteriaCode)

transformations.name: nc_data
transformations.expression: struct('N' as ncEmissionTypeCode, '55639.40-2' as otcIssuerAccountCode, codigo_tipo_emissao as issueTypeCode, codigo_conta_contabil_otc as otcBookkeeperAccountCode, cast(informacoes_adicionais.numero_da_emissao as int) as issueNumber, informacoes_adicionais.numero_da_serie as serieNumber, data_emissao_contrato as issueDate, max_data_vencimento_parcela as maturityDate, data_referencia as profitabilityStartDate, cast(informacoes_adicionais.quantidade_emitida as int) as issuedQuantity, cast(informacoes_adicionais.valor_da_unidade_de_emissao as double) as unitIssueValue, cast(cast(informacoes_adicionais.quantidade_emitida as double) * cast(informacoes_adicionais.valor_da_unidade_de_emissao as double) as double) as issueFinancialValue, codigo_regime_tributario as regimeTypeCode, indicador_processamento_cetip as cetipEventAttendedIndicator, 'PRIVADAVERT' as cvmRegistrationNumber, 1 as cvmSequentialNumber, cast('2026-01-12' as date) as cvmRegistrationDate, indicador_resgate_antecipado_unilateral as unilateralEarlyRedemptionIndicator, informacoes_adicionais.nome_fiador as guarantorName, indicador_presenca_agente_fiduciario as fiduciaryAgentIndicator, nome_sacado as issuerName, documento_sacado as issuerDocumentNumber, cast(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_tipo_garantia as int) as guaranteeTypeCode, payment_method as paymentMethod)

transformations.name: payload
transformations.expression: struct(id_vert as id_externo, struct(nc_data as nc) as data)

transformations.name: parcelas
transformations.expression: collect_list(struct(concat(numero_contrato, '1') as codigo_controle_parcela_contrato_if, 1 as numero_parcela)) over (partition by numero_contrato)

columns.name: headers
columns.expression: array(struct(cast('type' as string) as key, cast('REGISTRO' as binary) as value), struct(cast('kind' as string) as key, cast('ENVIO' as binary) as value))
